name: com.rabear.rcore.sheetx
description:
Excel and Google Sheets exporter for Unity data tables, IDs, constants, JSON, and localizations, with optional runtime collection bases and an Editor-only typed JSON bake workflow. Use SheetX interactively through its Settings and exporter windows, or programmatically through SheetXExporter with caller-owned output and structured diagnostics.
Deterministic, culture-invariant generated data keeps source spreadsheets reproducible across machines. Google OAuth credentials stay in EditorPrefs and authorization tokens stay under Library/SheetX, outside assets and version control.

samples.description: Folder layout and annotated-sheet starter reference.
